artifact.view: all five phases; six-page report; count CSV

categories.label: Usefulness and completeness
categories.assessment: All five phases and three submission files checked against the supplied brief. Registration and live evaluation are outside the file audit.

categories.label: Analytical clarity
categories.assessment: Five phase guides and the README simplified; formulas, settings, reasons and limits retained. Team understanding is not certified.

categories.label: Visual and interaction consistency
categories.assessment: Six report pages and eleven figures; bonus page/figure inspected and ten original PNG outputs verified byte-identical.

categories.label: Source authority and confidence
categories.assessment: All models use the supplied CSVs; original-source hashes match across all five artifacts.

categories.label: Calculation and value accuracy
categories.assessment: Independent reconstruction verifies five phase-score groups and the count submission; all numerical checks pass. Grid fits were regenerated, not each independently refitted.

categories.label: Within-chart agreement
categories.assessment: Ten unchanged main figures plus one bonus figure with independently reconstructed metrics.

categories.label: Complete source details
categories.assessment: Not applicable: no dashboard source-detail panels. CSV paths, fitted transformations and source hashes are recorded in the notebook/artifacts.
categories.reason: This notebook/PDF project has no dashboard source-detail panels; sources are recorded through CSV paths, preprocessing and hashes.

categories.label: Cross-artifact consistency
categories.assessment: Five phase-result groups agree across saved artifacts, displayed summaries and the report; submission reproduces final saved weights.

categories.label: Data-quality controls
categories.assessment: Phase inputs preserve split IDs and training-only preprocessing; original hashes and final submission schema/order checked.

categories.label: Conclusion support
categories.assessment: All five phase interpretations retain the small gains, conflicting temporal ranking and repeated-validation limits. No full-mark or causal claim is made.
